summary: Implemented new public Articles list/detail routes and navigation, added My Submissions page and frontend hooks, and updated backend Story model to store submitter Principal (with a migration). However, backend support for returning caller submissions with Pending/Published status is not evidenced in the diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend exposes a query method that returns the caller’s submissions with a status field (Pending/Published).
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend calls `actor.getMySubmissions()` and expects `SubmissionStatus[]`, but the diff summary for `backend/main.mo` does not show any `getMySubmissions` (or equivalent) query method nor any status computation (Pending vs Published).

hallucinated_features.description: Added backend state migration module to retrofit `authorPrincipal` into existing persisted stories/published titles.
hallucinated_features.reason: Migration work was not requested by any REQ; it may be useful, but it is additional scope beyond the stated requirements.

hallucinated_features.description: Global UI/theme changes (pastel blue OKLCH tokens, dark-blue mode, tailwind config updates).
hallucinated_features.reason: No requirement requested design system/theme rework; requirements focused on Articles/My Submissions flow and confirmation UI.

hallucinated_features.description: Enhanced error handling/diagnostics on the published stories feed (retry progress indicators, troubleshooting links, diagnostics panel).
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by REQ-1/REQ-2/REQ-3; extra UX/diagnostic functionality.

hallucinated_features.description: Added comments section to the new Article detail page (composer + thread).
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-1 only asked to reuse existing published story feed/detail functionality to view full content; explicitly adding a comments UI to the new Articles detail page is additional behavior not stated in the request.
